senses.gloss:
m. (-वः)
The sugar cane.

m. (-क्षुः)
The sugar cane.
E.
इष to desire, and क्सु affix or ईक्ष to see, असुन् affix and ई made short.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A species of sugar cane, (Saccharum munja, Rox.) see मुञ्ज.
2 A sort of grass, (Kās,) (Saccharum spontaneum.)
3 The stem or cane of the Saccharum officinale, the sugar cane.
E.
इक्षु and काण्ड a stem.

f. (-न्धा)
1 A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
2 Barleria longifolia, (this and its synonyms are also applied to Capparis spinosa and Tribulus lanuginosus: see कोकिलाक्ष and गोक्षुरक.)
3 Convolvulus paniculatus: भूमिकुष्माण्ड.
E.
इक्षु and गन्ध smell; having the odor of the sugar cane.

f. (-का)
Convolvulus paniculatus.
E.
see the preceding.

f. (-ल्या)
A species of grass or reed.
E.
इक्षु and तुल्या like, like sugar cane.

n. (-ण्डं)
The stem or cane of the Saccharum officinale, the sugar cane.
E.
इक्षु and दण्ड a staff.

f. (-र्भा)
A kind of grass; also वंशमूल, &c.

(-त्रं)
A kind of tree.
E.
इक्षु and नेत्र an eye.

m. (-त्रः)
A species of grain, Jowar, (Panicum spicatum).
E.
इक्षु and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-प्रः)
A sort of grass, (Saccharum sara.)

f. (-का)
1 A kind of reed: see इक्ष्वालिका.
2 Saccharum spontaneum.
E.
इक्षु and बालिका an infant; a young sugar cane, from its smaller size.

f. (-का)
A meal of sugar or molasses.
E.
इक्षु, भक्ष to eat, ण्वुच् aff.

f. (-ती)
The name of a river in Bengal.
E.
इक्षु and मतुप् aff. in this sense.

n. (-लं)
1 A sort of tree; also इक्षुनेत्र.
2 The root of sugar cane.
E.
इक्षु and मूल a root.

m. (-हः)
Diabetes, or D. mellitus.
E.
इक्षु and मेह urine.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Diabetic.
E.
इक्षुमेह and इनि aff.

n. (-न्त्रं)
A sugar mill.
E.
इक्षु and यन्त्र a machine.

m. (-निः)
The common sugar cane.
E.
इक्षु and योनि origin.

m. (-रः)
1 Sugar cane.
2 Barleria longifolia or Tribulus lanuginosus.
3 Saccharum spontaneum.
E.
इक्षु sugar, and र what gives, from रा and ड aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Saccharum spontaneum.
2 Barleria longifolia: see the preceding, कन् being added.

m. (-सः)
1 The juice of the sugar cane.
2 Molasses, unrefined sugar.
3 A sort of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
E.
इक्षु and रस juice.

m. (-थः)
Raw or unrefined sugar, molasses.
E.
इक्षुरस and क्वाथ a decoction, the boiled or inspissated juice.

m. (-दः)
The sea of syrup.
E.
इक्षुरस and उद water.

f. (-का)
A kind of sugar cane, the common yellow cane; also इक्षुवाटी; see पुण्ड्र.

m. (-रः)
1 Sugar, molasses.
2 Any sweetmeat.
E.
इक्षु and विकार change of form.

m. (-नः)
A sort of grass, (Saccharum munja.)
E.
इक्षु and वेष्टन surrounding.

n. (-टं)
A field of sugar cane.
E.
इक्षु and शाकट a field.

n. (-नं)
A field of sugar cane.
E.
इक्षु and शाकिन a field in this compound.

m. (-रः)
Molasses, raw or unrefined sugar.
E.
इक्षु and सार essence, the essence of the sugar cane.

m. (-कुः)
The son of the Menu VAIVASVATA, the son of SŪRYA or the sun, and first prince of the solar dynasty: he reigned at Ayodhya in the commencement of the second Yuga or age.
f. (-कुः)
A bitter gourd.
E.
इक्षु and अक to obtain, and कु or उण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
f. (-का)
Another sort, (Saccharum fuscum); the native pens are made from its stem.
E.
इक्षु and आलिका for आली a line; it grows like the sugar cane.

n. (-णं)
1 Sight, seeing.
2 An eye.
E.
ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-का)
A female fortune-teller.
E.
ईक्षण seeing, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Looking at, surveying.
E.
ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Seen, beheld.
E.
ईक्ष and क्त aff.
